decks.notes: This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty into play early on. The deck also utilizes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to control the game and protect the combo pieces. With a mix of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending, as well as counter magic like Spell Pierce, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own combo win condition. The deck also includes Leyline Binding to lock down threats on the board.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out big threats like Archon of Cruelty early in the game. It also includes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Leyline Binding to control the board. The inclusion of Dwarven Mine and Transmogrify adds flexibility to the combo strategy. The deck's unique mix of combo pieces, removal, and control elements allows for creative and unexpected plays that can catch opponents off guard. This deck rewards players who can think outside the box and adapt their strategy on the fly.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy through counterspells, removal spells, and other disruptive cards. By utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Teferi, Time Raveler, along with versatile cards like Archmage's Charm and Supreme Verdict, the deck aims to stall the game and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of Chalice of the Void and Leyline Binding helps to further shut down opposing strategies, while the mana base is optimized for consistency and flexibility.

The main concept of this deck is to cycle through cards quickly and efficiently, using cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will to set up for a powerful combo involving Living End. By filling up the graveyard with creatures, the player can then cast Living End to bring back a board full of powerful creatures while clearing the opponent's board at the same time. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Negation to protect the combo and disruptive creatures like Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to control the game until it can execute its explosive combo.

This deck focuses on using Amulet of Vigor to accelerate mana production and quickly ramp into playing Primeval Titan. The key concept revolves around tutoring for specific lands with Primeval Titan, such as bouncelands and utility lands like Gruul Turf and Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion, to generate a significant advantage. The inclusion of Dryad of the Ilysian Grove allows for additional land plays each turn and helps enable the deck's combo potential. Additionally, the deck utilizes Urza's Saga as a versatile tool to find key artifacts and ensure consistency in executing its game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing efficient and low-cost spells to quickly establish board presence and apply pressure on the opponent. Cards like Mishra's Bauble, Expressive Iteration, and Dragon's Rage Channeler help cycle through the deck and find the key creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent. With a mix of burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, along with countermagic in the form of Counterspell and Spell Pierce, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while developing its own threats to secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of removal spells and ramp to eventually reach the win condition of Scapeshift. By using cards like Bring to Light and Omnath, Locus of Creation, the deck can quickly assemble the needed lands and reach Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to deal lethal damage to the opponent. Wrenn and Six helps to recur lands and provide incremental advantage, while cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Valki, God of Lies offer additional threats and disruption. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent and win through a powerful combo finish.

This deck focuses on quickly casting cascade spells to overwhelm the opponent with threats. By utilizing cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent, the deck aims to cascade into Crashing Footfalls to flood the board with 4/4 rhinos. Additional control elements like Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute help protect your game plan while cards like Dead / Gone and Murktide Regent provide additional pressure. The deck also includes a land base that allows for flexibility in casting spells and maintaining consistency in mana production.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo of Puresteel Paladin and Colossus Hammer to create a powerful, indestructible threat early in the game. By utilizing cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Steelshaper's Gift to tutor for the necessary pieces, the deck aims to equip the Paladin with the Hammer and other valuable equipment cards like Sword of Fire and Ice or Shadowspear to deal massive damage quickly. The inclusion of Urza's Saga and Sigarda's Aid helps to streamline the combo and protect against disruption from opponents, allowing for explosive wins.

The deck revolves around utilizing the Amulet of Vigor to generate extra mana and play Primeval Titan as early as possible, searching for lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion to deal massive damage quickly. The inclusion of cards like Arboreal Grazer, Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, and Azusa, Lost but Seeking help ramp up mana production, allowing for explosive plays. Additionally, the deck utilizes lands like Urza's Saga and Tolaria West to search for key pieces of the combo.

This deck focuses on casting spells with Cascade, allowing you to cast additional spells for free and overwhelm your opponent with aggressive plays. By combining aggressive creatures like Murktide Regent with powerful Cascade spells like Crashing Footfalls and Violent Outburst, you can quickly build a board presence and apply pressure on your opponent. The deck also includes versatile spells like Dead / Gone and Force of Negation to control the board and protect your threats. Overall, the key strategy is to cascade into threats and disrupt your opponent's game plan while maintaining a strong board presence.

The deck focuses on using cycling creatures like Architects of Will, Grief, and Striped Riverwinder to quickly fill up the graveyard, then casting Living End to return all creatures from the graveyard to the battlefield. This allows the player to overwhelm their opponent with a sudden board presence, while also disrupting their opponent's game plan with cards like Force of Negation and Shardless Agent. The deck aims to outvalue and outpace the opponent, quickly closing out the game with a large board presence and disruptive spells.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to maintain control of the board while constantly applying pressure with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Murktide Regent. With a mix of counterspells, removal, and card selection spells, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while presenting a fast clock. The deck's synergy with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration allows for consistent card advantage and smooth gameplay. Additionally, the deck is capable of adapting to different situations with versatile spells like Lightning Bolt and Dress Down.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly deploy aggressive creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker, Grief, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while disrupting your opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate. Seasoned Pyromancer helps generate card advantage and Feign Death and Undying Malice provide ways to protect and recur your threats. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can provide a big finisher, and cards like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt help deal with any threats your opponent may have. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements efficiently.

The main concept of this deck is to have a fast and aggressive playstyle using low-cost spells and creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck focuses on dealing damage early on with creatures like Sprite Dragon, Monastery Swiftspear, and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while using spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart for removal or to finish off the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help with card advantage and card selection, ensuring a consistent and efficient aggressive strategy throughout the game.

Utilizing creatures with various abilities to assemble a powerful combination that can be searched for and deployed quickly, leveraging cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution as well as Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, this deck aims to create a versatile and resilient toolbox of creatures. With the ability to gain incremental advantages through life gain, sacrifice synergies, and card advantage, while also having access to disruptive elements like Endurance, the deck can adapt to a variety of situations and strategies, making it a formidable opponent in Modern 1 vs 1 matchups.
